article_content: Former X Factor judge Tulisa Contostavlos has appeared in court to face charges of assaulting a celebrity blogger, Savvas Morgan. The incident allegedly took place at the V Festival in Chelmsford, Essex. According to eyewitnesses, Contostavlos was 'behaving very aggressively' before the incident. The court heard that there was a long history of tension between Contostavlos and Morgan, with Morgan having published a sex tape involving the singer on his website. Contostavlos has pleaded not guilty to the charge and claims she was acting in self-defense.

article_content: Golfer Rory McIlroy and tennis star Caroline Wozniacki kicked off 2014 by announcing their engagement on social media. In a nod to modern times, they utilized their respective Twitter accounts to share the news with their millions of followers, posting photos of themselves with a ring. Northern Ireland's McIlroy, who ended 2013 as the sixth-ranked golfer globally, tweeted: 'Happy New Year everyone! I have a feeling it's going to be a great year!! My first victory of 2014 .she said yes!!' Former world number one Wozniacki, from Denmark, reported: 'Happy New Year everyone! Rory and I started 2014 with a bang! ... I said YES!!!!' The pair have been dating since September 2011, but if media rumors are to be believed, their romance has endured some challenging moments, particularly as both slipped down the rankings in their respective sports in 2013. However, the pair were clearly a solid item when strolling down the fairways at the World Tour Championship in Dubai in November, with the Dane following McIlroy every step of the way in the European Tour finale. This also signaled a return to form for McIlroy, who ended the year by claiming victory at the Australian Open last month. Wozniacki also regained her place in the top 10 of the WTA rankings with her sole tournament win of 2013 coming at the back end of the year in Luxembourg. It served as a promise that both will restore their respective fortunes, with two-time major winner McIlroy also looking to move back to the No.1 spot now occupied by his Nike stablemate Tiger Woods.
